title: Carrying mattresses to jobs and thankful for his reception everywhere
summary: Emile recalls hauling mattresses to jobs for players to sleep on and says he was well received everywhere he went.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: Yeah, he's just a little bit of an island. He'd have work there and all. Well, myself, I used to do that. I used to have 15 or 20 mattresses to go out. People would sleep on the floor. I'd go out for a job, down a half job, I'd leave 10 or 15 hours in it. And what I'd do? We'd stop in the island, I'd spend that up and go in the park and get some more. Let that go. No, no. And everywhere I went, it was that same thing. That's what I tell any man, I'm thankful. I went everywhere and my places where there wasn't no good. And I got in, they come out there, it's just like I went in, I put no kind of blunder, whatever. No hard word or nothing now. Everybody said, one boy, one boy, one boy, one boy, one boy. That's true.
